claims.statement: Tom Allen advertised free concerts every evening at his place at 619 Market Street, St. Louis, with only the best singers engaged.
claims.excerpt: retired champion pugilist of the Wworla, 619 Market street. Free concert.

claims.statement: Tom Allen was advertised as retired champion pugilist of the world (printed as 'Wworla').
claims.excerpt: Tom ALLEN, retired champion pugilist of the Wworla

notes: Advertisement only. Allen does nothing else in the text; the rest of the page is about billiards and baseball.
